b: The Frogg Toggs giveaway has ended: Were you one of the lucky winners?

Congratulations to our five winners! We’ll be reaching out to you so we can get your prize package headed your way. Thanks for entering! As always, keep an eye out for more weekly giveaways from Wired2fish.

Fall is one of the best times of year to hit the water. Cooler temperatures, changing conditions, and hungry fish make it the perfect season to chase bass, trout, and whatever else is biting in your neck of the woods. But to make the most of every outing, you need the right gear.

Wired2fish was proud to partner with Frogg Toggs to give five lucky anglers each a complete fall fishing package valued at almost $870. It includes weather-ready outerwear, dependable wading gear, comfortable footwear, and tackle storage to help you make the most of your time on the water. Whether you’re wading a favorite trout stream, fishing from the boat, or working the banks for bass, this prize package has you covered from head to toe.
What’s in Frogg Toggs’ Fall Fishing Package

This Frogg Toggs fishing package equips five lucky winners with the essentials for fall fishing adventures. It’s the perfect setup for anglers who aren’t ready to put their fishing gear away just because the temperatures start dropping. Keep reading to check out what’s included.
Frogg Toggs Men’s Pilot 4.0 Guide Jacket

Stay comfortable when the weather turns with the Pilot 4.0 Guide Jacket. Built with 15,000mm waterproof protection, 10,000g breathability, and flexible four-way stretch fabric, this jacket is designed to keep anglers protected without sacrificing mobility. A water-resistant YKK AquaGuard® front zipper, adjustable vented hood, wrist gaskets, and zippered chest and hand-warmer pockets make it a reliable choice for cool, wet days on the water.
Frogg Toggs Men’s Pilot 4.0 Guide Bib

Pair the Pilot 4.0 Jacket with these performance-ready bibs for serious protection against fall weather. Featuring the same 15,000mm waterproof rating, 10,000g breathability, and four-way stretch construction, the Pilot 4.0 Bib is built for comfort and mobility in challenging conditions. Full-length leg zippers make getting in and out easy, while adjustable suspenders, a secure waist closure, and four zippered pockets provide a practical fit and convenient storage.
Frogg Toggs Men’s Rockslide STFT Chest Wader

When the fish are holding in deeper water, the Rockslide STFT Chest Wader helps you get to them. Its durable four-ply nylon upper delivers breathable waterproof protection, while ergonomic 3mm neoprene booties provide warmth and comfort. Adjustable Y-back suspenders, a quick-release wading belt, integrated gravel guards, and secure chest and interior pockets make this a dependable option for anglers exploring streams, rivers, and other wade-fishing destinations.
Frogg Toggs Men’s Rana Elite Lug Sole Wading Boots

Complete your wading setup with the Rana Elite Lug Sole Wading Boots. A durable 900-denier nylon upper, double-padded collar, and protective internal toe cap provide comfort and support, while the lug outsole offers traction across varied terrain. Corrosion-resistant lace loops and speed rings round out a boot built to handle demanding days on the water.
Frogg Toggs Pro Series 3600 Tackle Bag with Three 3600 Trays

Keep your fishing essentials organized and ready for action with the Pro Series 3600 Tackle Bag. Three included 3600 tackle trays give you a convenient place to organize lures, terminal tackle, and other must-have gear. Front and top access offer flexible storage configurations, while integrated line-spooling grommets, additional accessory compartments, a mesh rear pouch, and a removable shoulder strap make this bag a versatile companion for trips to the lake, river, or boat.

Not every fishing trip calls for chest waders. The Hydrogrip Sneakers are made for comfortable days aboard the boat and other on-the-water adventures. A quick-drying, breathable mesh upper helps keep feet comfortable, while FroggFoam super-cushioned insoles provide all-day cushioning. A slip-on athletic fit, antimicrobial treatment, and non-marking outsoles make these sneakers a practical addition to any angler’s footwear lineup.

Frogg Toggs’ giveaway dates ran from Oct. 26 to Nov. 9. This giveaway was open to entrants from both the U.S. and Canada. Five winners were selected at random from all eligible entries. Each received the items (in the size and color of their choosing) included in the full prize package listed above, valued at a total of nearly $870. This giveaway has ended.
